opened.title: fix(rac1/pal): triage overlay assembly from its own directory
opened.author: llesieur99
opened.untrustedBody:
## Problem

`games/rac1/tools/triage.py` only looked in the executable's `asm/nonmatchings` directories. Unmatched level functions consequently appeared blocked by missing assembly even when their assembly was present under `asm/overlays`.

## Change

- Recognize level symbols with the existing `rank_candidates.OVERLAY_NAME` pattern and use its `OVERLAY_ASM` directory.
- Classify those bodies as game text, as `rank_candidates.check_names` already does.
- Preserve executable routing, genuine blocker classification and missing-assembly checks.
- Add five asset-free regression tests for shared/level overlays, missing overlay assembly, game text and core text.

With the PAL snapshot from #71 and locally supplied assembly, this fixes 14 false missing-assembly reports: 12 entries return to the work queue, while two remain correctly blocked as handwritten assembly. The counts depend on that source snapshot; some entries are joined fragments rather than independent C functions.

This is a tool

opened.title: feat(port): add WIP lighting, water and rendering improvements
opened.author: pezzadev
opened.untrustedBody:
This adds an initial interior-lighting pass to baked probe GI, enhanced Novalis water, and rendering improvements. Interior illumination uses authored lighting sets to guide bounded boosts to explicit emitters and procedural ceiling lights. It aims for the original mood rather than an exact lighting match.

**Very WIP:** loads of interiors can still be too dark, I am still focusing on Novalis as my vertical slice. 
Generated lights need visual tuning, and emission coverage depends on explicit material definitions.

## Changes

- Share emission settings between export, runtime and baking. Improve local probe coverage, merging, partitioning, alignment and three-volume blending. Add GPU-driven probe spheres, volume bounds and ceiling-light diagnostics.
- Add baked Novalis water boundaries, hydraulic data and subdivision meshes; GPU water simulation and UV animation; body/hand wakes; and a drying wetness coating for Ratchet. Other levels retain their existing water path.

opened.title: Match Orxon sliding update (PAL v2 / NTSC-U, 408 bytes)
opened.author: llesieur99
opened.untrustedBody:
## Summary
- Reconstruct `func_L10_002C0348` as ordinary C after the boundary correction merged in #129.
- Strictly match all **408 bytes** on **PAL v2 and NTSC-U**, including resolved references.
- Change only one source function, its US map entry, and the two associated reports. Based directly on current `main` (`4eb9b715`); no monorepo import, compiler changes, register pins, dummy arguments, empty-asm barriers, or HLE.

## Verified
- Full PAL executable rebuild: **1,244/1,244 decompiled executable functions exact**, all retail addresses preserved, **zero image-byte differences**.
- Full overlay-report rebuild; the only changed per-function result is this function, adding exactly **408 matched bytes**. The Orxon-specific report unit is now 57/57 finished (not a claim that all shared game code is complete).
- Whole affected source-file check: zero problems.
- Strict NTSC-U check against the locally extracted US retail image: EXACT.
- **116 public tests passed**; whitespace check pass

The wrapper's allocated sections remain unchanged and its nine existing placements pass; this adds no matching credit.

merged.title: feat(src): carry over 129 verified RC2 fork functions
merged.author: atlasbez-dot
merged.untrustedBody:
## Change

Carries over **129 canonical C implementations** from [atlasbez-dot/rac2-gc-decomp](https://github.com/atlasbez-dot/rac2-gc-decomp), preserving the existing source bytes, complete licence notices and per-file compiler profiles. Only C sources and `config/cflags.txt` differ from current upstream base `a4e6b395f9474bfe8a2038f2d53c4560e45c8167`. Generated progress stays with maintainers.

The command-byte reader **`func_002A04B8` is excluded from the final change**. Its exact fork version requires explicit register bindings and an empty compiler barrier, which do not meet current source rules. Plain-C extraction, packed representations and documented scheduling/register-availability profiles did not match its retail allocation and scheduling. The existing upstream nonmatching C and assembly marker are preserved, the exact fork version remains in fork history, and no `ASM_FUNC` classification or new match is claimed for it.

merged.title: fix(nonmatching): recover lifetimes in three large dispatchers
merged.author: llesieur99
merged.untrustedBody:
Three retained large dispatchers still differ from retail. This change preserves newly measured address forms and lifetimes so the next attempt starts from the corrected sources instead of repeating the same failed models. None is promoted into the linked build.

- **Oozla `func_L01_003B5878`:** separate the four real scalar objects from the complete vector/matrix workspace. The F21 zero now follows the retail scale-call/store/comparison lifetime with unchanged scalar stack slots. Replace the forced SDA alias with one `MACRO_ADDR` frame-counter declaration; both USA releases independently confirm that its absolute and GP reads address the same object. Still 4968/4972 bytes.
- **Dobbo `func_L22_002BF1B0`:** type the two measured resident fields and retain one real combined pose predicate across the path calls, preserving the unconditional table read. The entry object returns to fp without extra references. All 147 table slots retain the 63 retail destination classes; frame, FPR and text
